shell.switchHint: Simple shows the essentials. Full shows every page and tool. Your timeline is the same in both.
shell.intro: This is the simple editor: the essentials for a first video. Every page and tool is in the full editor, one click away.
shell.needsFullBody: Your timeline stays as it is.

tasks.lead: What do you want to do? Pick a task, or select a clip on the timeline to change it.
tasks.leadEmpty: Start by dragging a file from Media onto the timeline. Then pick a task here.
tasks.selectHint: Select a clip to trim it, move it, or change its speed, size and volume.

silence.title: Remove the silences
silence.hint: Finds the quiet parts and cuts them in one step. Free.

captions.title: Add captions
captions.hint: Writes captions from what is said. Reading the speech uses credits; you see the price first.

title.title: Add a title
title.hint: Words on the picture, at the playhead.

beats.title: Cut to the music
beats.hint: Finds the beats in your music and lines the cuts up with them. Free.

sound.title: Fix the sound
sound.hint: Track volume, music that lowers under a voice, a cleaner voice, a voice-over.

format.title: Change the shape
format.hint: Vertical, square or wide, and the frame rate.

tighten.title: Tighten the edit
tighten.hint: A helper suggests cuts. You see the price first and accept only what you like.

placeholders.recut: Ask for a change, for example: cut the pauses in the first half
placeholders.graphics: Ask for a change, for example: add a title with the product name
placeholders.grade: Ask for a change, for example: make it warmer
placeholders.sfx: Ask for a change, for example: add a whoosh on each cut
placeholders.review: Ask for a check, for example: is the opening too slow?

selection.captionLead: A caption is edited with the others, so the words stay in step.
selection.otherItem: {name} is edited in the full editor. It plays and exports here as it is.
selection.fullWorkLead: This clip has work made in the full editor: {list}.
selection.fullWorkNote: It shows in the picture and in your export. Change it in the full editor.

work.colour: {count, plural, one {# colour step} other {# colour steps}}

selection.animatedNote: Animated in the full editor. Change it there.
selection.many: {count, plural, one {# clip selected} other {# clips selected}}
selection.manyHint: Select one clip to change its picture, speed or volume.
